tools.name: text_metrics
tools.description: Text metrics for Arabic (or any) text: counts, language mix, sentence/word stats, reading time.

tools.name: text_normalize
tools.description: Normalize Arabic text: strip tashkeel/tatweel, fold alef/ya/ta-marbuta, unify digits, remove bidi control characters, collapse whitespace.

tools.name: audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file to clean text (Arabic or English).

tools.name: doc_extract
tools.description: Extract structured fields from an Arabic document image or PDF (receipts, invoices, IDs).
